node.title: Re: search for 'cat' not followed by 'dog'
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Sounds like you're looking for [doc://perlre#Lookaround-Assertions|negative lookahead]: [https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html#flags=®ex=cat(%3F!%5Cs*dog)&samp1=we%20have%20catnip%20for%20sale&samp2=my%20cat%20eats%20dogs&samp3=I%20sell%20hot%20cat%20dogs|/cat(?!\s*dog)/] (link goes to interactive regex tester, modern browser required)

See also [id://1201201].
